log: Nothing has read the per-turn power cache since `shouldAttack` went in civ-clone/web-renderer#434; rivals and invasions work power out directly through core-power (civ-clone/web-renderer#438).

`couldJoin` checked the city's `CanJoinCity` rules but not whether the unit is a kind the ruleset offers `JoinCity` to, so in a ruleset with a worker that can't join, it was sent to a city "it could join" and waited there. It now also looks the actions up as if standing in the city, unless the unit has no moves left, when only `NoOrders` is offered (civ-clone/web-renderer#254).
